biotools.summary: The Rodent Genome and Pathogen Atlas is a comprehensive database and analysis platform integrating rodent genomics, pathogen sequences, and epidemiological profiles to facilitate biomedical research. It provides tools for comparative genomic analysis and pathogen exploration within rodent species.
